# dagsterplus_team_membership (Resource)

Manages a single user's membership in a Dagster+ team. Use this resource when the team itself is managed separately. If you manage the team with dagsterplus_team, prefer the inline member block instead.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to add to the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier in the form '{team_id}/{user_id}'.
